name: Baroque Apocalypse
description: Baroque Apocalypse fuses Caravaggio's dramatic chiaroscuro with post-apocalyptic fantasy. Ghostly warriors in tarnished armor, scorched battlefields with torn banners, crumbling baroque palaces where gold leaf peels from walls. Extreme light and shadow, warm firelight against pitch darkness, opulent decay rendered with classical painting technique. Inspired by Caravaggio's theatrical lighting, Luis Royo's dark fantasy, and Beksiński's dystopian nightmares.
